div.p: An optional child element of agent, formAvailable, function, place, subject, and relation that indicates the role of the related entity towards the entity being described in the EAS instance.
An optional child element of agent, place and relation that indicates the role of the related entity towards the entity being described in the EAS instance.
An optional child element of agent and relation that indicates the role of the related entity towards the entity being described in the EAS instance.
agent, formAvailable, function, place, subject, relation
Use role to indicate the role of the related entity towards the entity being described in the EAS instance. It is recommended that the terms in role be taken from authorized vocabularies.

role might be used in combination with the specific type attribute available with each of the entity elements where role is available. While these attributes provide a generic typology of each entity class, e.g. "corporateBody", "person", and "family" for agentType, role looks more specifically at the related entity itself in a certain context. Furthermore, role may be used in combination with relationship which is available in agent, function, place and subject. While relationship gives again a more general indication about the relationship between the related and the described entity, e.g. "creation", role allows to be more specific to the individual related entity, e.g. by assigning the role of "director" to one agent and the role of "playwright" to another.
